notes.chat_template: every model uses its OFFICIAL publisher template (local/official/*), passed with --chat-template-file; fidelity vs Python jinja2 is checked in integration
notes.no_speculative_decoding: no draft model, no MTP/DFlash, no n-gram speculation
notes.kv_cache: q8_0 for K and V, all models
notes.load_mode: none (no mmap): weights resident in private memory so RAM is measured unambiguously and no page-outs during long runs
notes.prompt_cache: disabled (-cram 0, cache_prompt=false) so every item is processed from scratch
notes.fit: --fit on with 1024 MiB VRAM margin chooses GPU layers / MoE expert placement automatically; n_ctx is always set explicitly so --fit never reduces context
notes.log_verbosity: -lv 4 so the load log records fit decisions, per-device model buffers, offloaded layers and KV size (offload is measured from these)

common_request.messages: single user message containing the rendered task prompt; no study system message
common_request.explicit_sampler_rule: every sampler parameter is set explicitly per request; llama.cpp defaults (top_k 40, top_p 0.95, min_p 0.05) must never apply

loop_early_stop.rule: abort generation when any 12-token n-gram occurs >= 20 times within the last 2048 generated tokens (checked every 64 tokens)
loop_early_stop.status: BUDGET_TRUNCATED with flag loop_terminated; scores 0; text retained for audit

watchdog.total_s_rule: 1.5 * max_tokens / p10_tok_per_s(model, from calibration) + 1800 for Stage 1; calibration uses 1.5 * max_tokens / 0.75 + 1800 (= 50,952 s at 24,576)
watchdog.on_trigger: INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE; up to 2 identical reruns, then MISSING
watchdog.change_log: 2026-10-02 19:55: calibration floor lowered from 2.0 to 0.75 tok/s before the dense models ran. Measured decode at 18K depth fell to 3.1 tok/s (Ministral) and 8 tok/s (R1); the old 5.6 h cap would have mislabelled genuine long dense-model attempts as INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE and rerun them. Hangs remain caught by the 600 s no-token stall rule.

calibration.rule: C1 = smallest ladder value L such that (a) no model has more than 1 of its 6 development attempts that ended naturally (finish_reason=stop) with completion_tokens > L, and (b) at most 2 of all 42 do. Loop-terminated and C_dev-truncated attempts are censored at every L and are not counted. Accuracy, runtime and model preference cannot influence C1.
calibration.n_ctx_rule: n_ctx = max_tokens + longest rendered prompt (this model's tokenizer, over calibration + Stage 1 items) + 1024, rounded up to a multiple of 256

stage1.time_box: reserve runs only if elapsed + projected <= 46 h; if core alone projects > 40 h, stop and report

stage1_v2.approved: 2026-10-02 (placement rule, 6,144 + 1,536 budget, ~24 h panel); Stage 1 EXECUTION NOT approved
stage1_v2.budget_message: Time is up. I must stop thinking now and give my final answer in the required format.
stage1_v2.max_tokens_note: 6,144 thinking + 1,536 answer + 128 for the injected message and end-of-thinking delimiters
stage1_v2.mechanism: llama-server --reasoning-budget 6144 --reasoning-budget-message <message>: when reasoning reaches the budget the server injects the message and the model's own end-of-thinking delimiter, then the model writes its answer. The harness stops an answer that exceeds 1,536 tokens (abort answer_allowance_exceeded -> BUDGET_TRUNCATED). Forced items are flagged forced_conclusion.
stage1_v2.placement_rule: attention + KV on GPU; FFN (dense) / experts (MoE) to CPU first, 1 GiB free-VRAM margin (local/placement.py). If all FFN on CPU still does not fit, whole layers are moved to CPU (recorded per model).
stage1_v2.n_ctx_rule: max_tokens + longest v2 prompt (this model's tokenizer) + 1024, rounded up to 256
stage1_v2.replaces: the C1 censoring-rule ceiling for Stage 1 (C1 = 24,576 kept as a calibration finding, see runs/calibration-20261002)
stage1_v2.forcing_mechanisms: server (--reasoning-budget) for models where it validated in the probe; harness two-phase for others (config models.<m>.forcing)
